about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Mansaf (Jordanian Lamb in Yoghurt Sauce with Rice)
recipes.summary: Tender lamb in a tangy cooked yoghurt sauce over rice and flatbread, topped with toasted almonds.
steps: Put the lamb, onion, bay and allspice in a pot, cover with water and simmer gently for 1 1/2 hours, until the lamb is very tender. Keep 3 cups of the broth.
Whisk the yoghurt and egg white in a pan, then stir in 2 cups of broth over low heat, always one direction, until it just simmers. Add the lamb and keep warm.
Cook the rice in salted water for 12 minutes, until tender. Toast the almonds in the butter for 2 minutes.
Tear the pita onto a platter, top with rice, lamb and sauce, then scatter with the almonds and parsley.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces should reach at least 70°C and be tender. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Stir the yoghurt in one direction over low heat so it does not split.

recipes.title: Chicken Kabsa (Saudi Spiced Rice with Chicken)
recipes.summary: Fragrant long grain rice cooked with tomato, warm spices and tender chicken, a Gulf family dish.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a large pot for 8 minutes. Lift out. Cook the onion for 8 minutes, then add garlic, tomato, paste and spices for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken with the stock. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes, until cooked through. Lift out and keep warm.
Rinse the rice, add to the pot with the sultanas, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes, until the stock is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes, until golden. Pile rice on a platter with the chicken and almonds.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Cool leftover rice quickly and eat within a day. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Tahchin (Persian Saffron Yoghurt and Chicken Rice Cake)
recipes.summary: A crisp-bottomed baked rice cake layered with saffron chicken, yoghurt and barberries.
steps: Steep the saffron in 3 tbsp hot water. Simmer the chicken and onion in water for 20 minutes, until cooked through. Shred.
Parboil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes. Drain. Mix half with the yoghurt, eggs, half the saffron water and 1 tsp salt.
Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Oil a 24cm dish and press the yoghurt rice into the base and sides.
Layer the chicken and sultanas, then the plain rice, mounded in the middle. Drizzle with the oil, melted butter and remaining saffron water. Cover with foil.
Bake for 1 hour, until the base is golden. Rest for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a plate.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Food safety: eggs should be cooked until the whites are fully set. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Shevid Polo ba Gusht (Persian Dill Rice with Braised Lamb)
recipes.summary: Herby dill rice served with lamb braised until falling off the bone.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil for 10 minutes, then add the onion and turmeric and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the water, cover and simmer gently for 2 hours, until the meat falls from the bone.
Parboil the rice for 6 minutes, until just tender outside. Drain and mix with the dill.
Melt the butter in a pot, layer in the rice, poke steam holes and cook covered on low with a tea towel under the lid for 25 minutes.
Serve the rice with the lamb and its juices.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces should reach at least 70°C and be tender. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Khoresh Gheimeh (Persian Split Pea and Lamb Stew)
recipes.summary: Lamb braised with split peas, tomato and dried lime, topped with crisp fried chips.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 10 minutes, then brown the lamb with the turmeric for 8 minutes.
Stir in the paste, split peas, cinnamon, pierced limes and water. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, until the lamb is tender and the peas soft.
Shallow fry the chips in oil for 8 minutes, until crisp.
Serve the stew over rice with chips on top.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces should reach at least 70°C and be tender. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tas Kebabi (Turkish Lamb and Vegetable Casserole)
recipes.summary: Cubed lamb braised with onion, tomato and capsicum, served with rice or bread.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the onion and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, paste, capsicum, tomato, oregano and water.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour, until the lamb is tender and the sauce is thick. Serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces should reach at least 70°C and be tender. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Kuzu Tandir (Turkish Slow-Roasted Lamb Shoulder)
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder roasted in a covered tin until it pulls apart, with garlic, tomato and oregano.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Stab the lamb all over and push in the garlic. Rub with oil, paste, oregano and 1 tsp salt.
Put the onion and water in a deep tin, rest the lamb on top and cover tightly with foil.
Roast for 3 hours, adding the potato for the last hour, until the lamb is falling apart.
Rest for 15 minutes, then shred and serve with the pan juices and potatoes.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces should reach at least 70°C and be tender. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Karides Güveç (Turkish Prawn Casserole)
recipes.summary: Prawns baked in a clay-pot style tomato and capsicum sauce topped with melted cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil for 8 minutes. Add garlic, tomatoes and chilli and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the prawns and tip into four small dishes.
Top with mozzarella and bake for 10 minutes, until the prawns are pink and the cheese is bubbling.
Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when it turns opaque and flakes easily; cook shellfish until opaque. Eat the same day or refrigerate within an hour and use within 24 hours.
Contains shellfish and milk.

recipes.title: Kokkinisto (Greek Beef in Red Tomato Sauce)
recipes.summary: Beef braised in a cinnamon-scented tomato and wine sauce, served with pasta or potatoes.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches for 10 minutes. Lift out. Cook the onion and garlic for 6 minutes.
Add the wine and boil for 2 minutes, then the tomatoes, paste, cinnamon, bay, water and beef.
Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, until the beef is very tender and the sauce thick.
Boil the pasta until tender and serve with the beef.
notes: Food safety: beef pieces are safe once they reach at least 70°C and are tender; braise until the meat pulls apart. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Lahanodolmades (Greek Cabbage Rolls with Mince and Rice)
recipes.summary: Cabbage leaves wrapped around spiced beef and rice, cooked in lemon and tomato sauce.
steps: Core the cabbage and simmer in salted water for 8 minutes. Peel off 12 soft leaves and trim the thick ribs.
Mix the mince, rice, onion, dill, paste, salt and pepper. Put 2 tbsp on each leaf, fold in the sides and roll up.
Pack seam-down in a pot lined with spare leaves. Add the oil, stock and lemon juice and weigh down with a plate.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes, until the rice and meat are cooked through.
Serve with the pan juices.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Pescado a la Veracruzana (Veracruz-Style Fish)
recipes.summary: Fish simmered in a tomato, olive, caper and green chilli sauce, a Gulf coast Mexican classic.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, tomatoes, olives, capers, chilli and bay. Simmer for 12 minutes, until thick.
Season the fish and nestle into the sauce.
Cover and cook for 8 minutes, until the fish is opaque and flakes.
Add the lime juice and serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when it turns opaque and flakes easily; cook shellfish until opaque. Eat the same day or refrigerate within an hour and use within 24 hours.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pollo Pibil (Yucatan Achiote Chicken in Banana Leaf Style)
recipes.summary: Chicken marinated in citrus and achiote, wrapped and slowly baked until tender.
steps: Blend the achiote, juices, garlic, cumin, oregano and 1 tsp salt. Coat the chicken well.
Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan). Wrap the chicken and marinade in baking paper and foil parcels.
Bake for 75 minutes, until tender and cooked through.
Pickle the onion in lime juice for 15 minutes. Shred the chicken, serve in warm tortillas with onion and wedges.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
For best flavour, marinate the chicken in the fridge for a few hours or overnight, never on the bench. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Tinga de Pollo (Shredded Chipotle Chicken)
recipes.summary: Shredded chicken in a smoky chipotle and tomato sauce, piled on crisp tostadas.
steps: Simmer the chicken in water for 18 minutes, until cooked through. Shred.
Blend the tomato, garlic and chipotle until smooth.
Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the sauce and stock and simmer for 8 minutes. Stir in the chicken for 5 minutes.
Crisp the tortillas under the grill and top with tinga, sour cream and coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains milk. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Curry Goat (Jamaican Curried Goat)
recipes.summary: Goat marinated in curry powder and thyme, simmered until meltingly tender.
steps: Rub the meat with half the curry powder, garlic, ginger and 1 tsp salt and marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Fry the remaining powder in the oil for 1 minute. Brown the meat for 10 minutes with the onion.
Add the thyme, whole chilli and water. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the potato and cook for 20 minutes, until the meat is tender and the sauce thick. Remove the chilli and serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces should reach at least 70°C and be tender. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
The whole chilli adds heat without bursting; take care when removing it. Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Stew Peas (Jamaican Red Bean and Pork Stew)
recipes.summary: Red kidney beans simmered in coconut milk with pork, thyme and spinners.
steps: Brown the pork for 8 minutes. Add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beans, coconut milk, thyme, whole chilli and 3 cups water. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes.
Mix the flour, 1/2 cup water and a pinch of salt into a dough and roll into small spinners.
Drop them in and cook for 15 minutes, until the stew is thick. Serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C in the centre, with clear juices, and rest before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free. Canned beans are already cooked.

recipes.title: Pastelón (Puerto Rican Plantain and Beef Lasagne)
recipes.summary: Layers of sweet plantain around spiced beef picadillo and cheese, baked until golden.
steps: Fry the plantain in oil for 4 minutes a side until golden. Drain.
Brown the mince for 8 minutes, add the onion, garlic and cumin for 5 minutes, then paste and olives for 3 minutes.
Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Layer half the plantain in a dish, top with half the cheese, all the beef, then the rest of the plantain.
Pour over the beaten eggs and top with the remaining cheese. Bake for 30 minutes, until set and golden.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Food safety: eggs should be cooked until the whites are fully set. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Moros y Cristianos (Cuban Black Beans and Rice with Pork)
recipes.summary: Black beans cooked with rice, pork and sofrito into one comforting pot.
steps: Brown the pork in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the onion, capsicum and garlic and cook for 8 minutes with the cumin.
Add the beans, rice, stock, vinegar and bay. Bring to a boil, then cover and cook on low for 20 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed.
Rest for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C in the centre, with clear juices, and rest before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Cool leftover rice quickly and eat within a day. Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Vaca Frita (Cuban Crispy Shredded Beef)
recipes.summary: Slow-simmered beef shredded then fried with garlic and lime until crisp at the edges.
steps: Simmer the steak with the halved onion and bay in water for 2 hours, until tender. Cool, then shred.
Toss the beef with the lime juice, garlic and 1 tsp salt and leave 15 minutes.
Fry the sliced onion in half the oil for 8 minutes. Add the beef and remaining oil in a hot pan and cook for 10 minutes without stirring much, until crisp and browned. Serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: beef pieces are safe once they reach at least 70°C and are tender; braise until the meat pulls apart. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Locro (Argentine Pumpkin, Corn and Pork Stew)
recipes.summary: A thick Andean stew of pumpkin, corn, beans and pork, traditionally served on national holidays.
steps: Brown the pork and chorizo in a heavy pot for 8 minutes. Add the onion, garlic and paprika for 5 minutes.
Add the pumpkin and water, cover and simmer for 1 hour, until the pork is tender.
Mash some of the pumpkin into the stew to thicken, then add the corn and beans for 15 minutes.
Season and serve in bowls topped with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C in the centre, with clear juices, and rest before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Sausages must reach 75°C. Dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tangia Marrakchia (Marrakech Slow-Cooked Beef Pot)
recipes.summary: Beef cooked for hours in a clay pot with preserved lemon, saffron and cumin, a street food classic.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Put the beef, garlic, cumin, ginger, saffron, lemon, oil, butter, 1 tsp salt and water into a heavy lidded pot.
Cover tightly with foil and the lid.
Cook for 3 1/2 hours, until the beef falls apart. Stir once in the middle, then serve with bread.
notes: Food safety: beef pieces are safe once they reach at least 70°C and are tender; braise until the meat pulls apart. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour and reheat until steaming hot.
Contains milk. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Barbunya Pilaki (Turkish Borlotti Beans in Tomato)
recipes.summary: Soft borlotti beans stewed with carrot, onion and tomato, served warm or cold with bread.
steps: Cook the onion and carrot in the oil for 10 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and paste for 2 minutes.
Add the beans, sugar, water and salt and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick.
Scatter with parsley and serve with lemon and bread.
notes: Vegan and dairy-free. Canned beans are already cooked.
